name: Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure
author: Mintu Community
description: Production Kubernetes Deployment, Service, and Ingress manifests, HPA autoscaling, Terraform cloud resources, and kubectl helper commands.
ai_rules: Always declare explicit CPU and memory resource requests and limits for all Kubernetes containers.
Implement livenessProbe and readinessProbe on all long-running service pods to ensure zero-downtime rolling updates.
Enforce non-root execution (securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true) and read-only root filesystems where applicable.

snippets.label: Kubernetes Production Deployment Manifest
snippets.body:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app-deployment
  labels:
    app: web-service
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: registry.example.com/app:v1.0.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "128Mi"
            cpu: "100m"
          limits:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "500m"
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10

snippets.label: Kubernetes ClusterIP / NodePort Service
snippets.body:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: app-service
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: web-service
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
